description: This file defines the SurveyResponses class, a module in SuiteCRM extending Basic, handling survey response data, email notifications, and case creation based on survey feedback.

classes.name: SurveyResponses
classes.description: Represents survey response records, manages email notifications, and creates cases for negative feedback.

methods.name: bean_implements
methods.description: Indicates the interfaces implemented by the bean, specifically ACL.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Saves the survey response, sends email notifications, and creates cases based on feedback.

methods.name: sendEmail
methods.description: Prepares and sends email using templates, logs email activity.

methods.name: populateTemplate
methods.description: Populates email templates with contact and case data.

methods.name: logEmail
methods.description: Logs email details into the Emails module.
